reason: I'd grab the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge, but I've already tried a bunch of sleep apps and none really changed anything, so I'm not paying until I see it. With my shifts changing, I doubt a morning check-in will tune it right for me in the first month.
objection: I've been burned by sleep apps that promise a lot. And if anything makes sound come back by accident at 3am after I finally drop off, I'm deleting it that night.
would_change_my_mind: If the day-14 record actually showed me falling asleep 10+ minutes faster, even on my rotating shift nights, I'd pay the 4,900.
